title: lilium pardalinum subsp. vollmeri
intro: Lilium pardalinum subsp. vollmeri, commonly known as the Cascade lily, is a subspecies of the Western tiger lily, characterized by its unique appearance and fragrance. The health benefits of Lilium pardalinum subsp. vollmeri include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. Its therapeutic actions include sedative and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and muscle spasms. Bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
